test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ISOLATE
solution:
The correct answer is 'detach.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Isolate' means **to put or keep somebody or something separate from other people or things**. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को अन्‍य व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं से अलग करना या रखना)

 
 
• Example: *We wanted to show how ridiculous it was to **isolate** yourselves*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of the given options:-
 
 
• 'Combine' means **to join or mix two or more things together**. (दो या अधिक वस्‍तुओं को जोड़ना या मिलाना)
 
 
• Example: *Hydrogen and oxygen **combine** to form water*.
 
 
 
• 'Detach' means **to leave or separate oneself or something from a group or place**. (किसी समूह या स्थान से स्वयं को या किसी चीज़ को छोड़ना या अलग करना)
 
 
• Example: *She tried to **detach** herself from the reality of these terrible events*.
 
 
 
• 'Connect' means **to have an association with somebody or something else**. (किसी के साथ संबंध होना)
 
 
• Example: *There was nothing to **connect** him with the crime*.
 
 
 
• 'Attach' means **to make somebody or something join or belong to somebody or something**. (से संबद्घ करना या होना)
 
 
• Example: *I advise you not to **attach** yourself to the party*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The synonyms of the word 'Isolate' are "detach, **seclude, separate**".
 
• The antonyms of the word 'Isolate' are "unite, connect, associate".
